INVALID_FILE_TYPE: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are accepted
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the {limit} MB limit
INVALID_UPLOAD: Send one image file in the "file" field and nothing else

TOO_MANY_FILES: Send at most {limit} files at once
